title: Rust for server and server-side tools
statement: The system shall implement its server engine (storage, Raft replication, GQL engine) and server-side tools (CLI, bulk importer) in Rust.
rationale: PO decision: Rust for memory safety and performance. The Kubernetes operator and the non-Rust client drivers are out of scope of this constraint.

acceptance_criteria.text: All first-party source in the server, CLI and importer repositories is Rust, built with a pinned stable Rust toolchain and cargo; CI fails if first-party C, C++ or Go source is added there.
Each first-party `unsafe` block carries a SAFETY comment, and CI reports the count of unsafe blocks per release.

notes: Open: minimum supported Rust version (MSRV) policy.
